title: Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Reservations: Cancellation by the Renter
content:
**Cancelling a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental reservation.** A reservation in reserved status is cancelled by the renter, and the cancellation is free when it is made at least the class free-cancellation hours before the scheduled pickup date and time; that free cancellation is unchanged. A cancellation made later than that posts a late cancellation fee, and the renter confirms that fee when cancelling. Once cancelled, the reservation stands in cancelled status.

## What the cancellation does

The cancellation is the renter's own act. Running it moves the reservation to cancelled status, with the cancellation date and time stamped at the moment it is run. When the fee given is above zero, a late cancellation fee line for that amount is posted to the same reservation, dated the cancellation date, and the amount owed on the reservation rises by it; a fee of 0.00 posts no fee line. The renter then sees the reservation listed as cancelled and, where a fee applies, the fee owed.

## How it is invoked

`cancel_truck_reservation_ee0618b8` is a hand-over tool owned by the customer. The agent unlocks it as a customer-side tool and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it, and in running it confirms the cancellation fee shown to them.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `truck_rental_id` | The truck rental contract number of the reservation being cancelled, as it stands among the renter's truck rentals in the truck rental lookup | Identifier, copied as recorded |
| `late_cancellation_fee` | The cancellation fee the renter accepts, in USD | Non-negative amount rounded to 2 decimal places; 0.00 when no fee applies |

## Return

On success the tool returns `status` "cancelled", `truck_rental_id` (the contract number cancelled), `cancelled_at` (the cancellation timestamp, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS with the time zone), `fee_charge_id` (the id of the posted fee line, or an empty value when no fee line was posted), `late_cancellation_fee` (the fee posted, USD with 2 decimal places) and `balance_due` (the amount now owed on the reservation, USD with 2 decimal places). A status of "cancelled" means the cancellation is recorded.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A renter cancels with a fee of 0.00: the reservation stands cancelled, `fee_charge_id` comes back empty and `balance_due` is unchanged. A renter cancels with a fee of 31.19: a fee line of 31.19 dated the cancellation date is posted and `balance_due` rises by 31.19.
